paper.title_en: Probing scalar-tensor-induced gravitational waves in the nHz band: NANOGrav and SKA
paper.abstract_en: Scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) have recently attracted considerable interest, both as a possible explanation for the nanohertz signal reported by the Pulsar Timing Array (PTA) collaboration and for their connection with primordial black hole (PBH) physics. In addition to SIGWs, scalar-tensor-induced gravitational waves (STGWs) have emerged as a promising cosmological source of the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB). In this paper, we compute the STGWs generated during a generic matter-dominated (MD) era, as well as during an early matter-dominated (eMD) epoch followed by a sudden transition to the standard radiation-dominated (RD) stage, working in the Poisson gauge. We find that, in a purely MD age, the corresponding energy density rapidly dilutes, whereas in the presence of an eMD phase it remains non-vanishing due to the short duration of the eMD period. We then investigate whether the STGW signal could provide a dominant contribution to the \texttt{NANOGrav 15-year} dataset and we forecast the prospects for its detection with future observations by the Square Kilometre Array (SKA). In particular, we consider STGWs generated during both eMD and RD eras, including their linear-order contributions. We further inject the scalar-induced contribution, both as an additional component and as the only signal, and compare the spectra against the same datasets. Our results show that, although the SIGWs still appear to provide the dominant contribution and the posteriors are tightly constrained by the requirement of avoiding PBH overproduction, the GWs induced by scalar-tensor mixing constitute a viable target for future, more sensitive nano-Hz detectors of the SGWB.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在Poisson规范下计算了物质主导时代及早期物质主导后突然转回辐射主导阶段所产生的标量-张量诱导引力波，并将其与NANOGrav 15年数据集进行对比、对SKA探测前景作预测，与PTA及随机引力波背景主题高度相关，理论推导与贝叶斯拟合流程较为具体，适合点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 探测nHz频段的标量-张量诱导引力波：NANOGrav与SKA
decision.abstract_zh: 标量诱导引力波（SIGWs）近来引起了相当大的兴趣，既作为脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）合作组所报道的纳赫兹信号的一种可能解释，也因它们与原初黑洞（PBH）物理的联系。除SIGWs之外，标量-张量诱导引力波（STGWs）已成为随机引力波背景（SGWB）的一个有前景的宇宙学来源。在本文中，我们在Poisson规范下计算了一般的物质主导（MD）时代期间，以及在一个早期物质主导（eMD）时期随后突然过渡到标准辐射主导（RD）阶段期间所产生的STGWs。我们发现，在纯粹MD时代，相应的能量密度迅速稀释，而在存在eMD阶段的情况下，由于eMD时期持续时间短，该能量密度保持非零。随后我们研究STGW信号是否能够对\texttt{NANOGrav 15-year}数据集提供主导贡献，并预测未来由平方公里阵列（SKA）进行探测的前景。特别地，我们考虑了在eMD和RD两个时代产生的STGWs，包括它们的线性阶贡献。我们进一步注入标量诱导贡献，既作为额外分量也作为唯一信号，并将谱与同一数据集进行比较。我们的结果表明，尽管SIGWs似乎仍提供主导贡献，且后验受到避免PBH过度产生这一要求的严格约束，但由标量-张量混合诱导的引力波构成未来更灵敏的纳赫兹SGWB探测器的可行目标。
